title: A Simple Crop Model Derived from STICS
text: miniSTICS simulation requires five types inputs: plant: plant parameters defining crop characteristics. soil: soil description initial soil water conditions. weather_station: geographical information weather station. practices: crop management parameters (sowing date, density, etc.). weather: daily weather data used model forcing. package provides example datasets inputs except plant parameters, generated using plant_parameters().

title: A Simple Crop Model Derived from STICS
text: information STICS model can found : Brisson et al. (1998). STICS: generic model simulation crops water nitrogen balances. Agronomie, 18(5–6), 311–346. Tremblay & Wallach (2004). Calibration crop model using Bayesian approach. Agronomie, 24(6–7), 351–365. Beaudoin et al. (2023). STICS soil-crop model: Conceptual framework, equations uses.

text: soil named list soil parameters miniSTICS model. Soil parameters grouped clarity. Initial conditions: hur1_init: Initial water content horizon 1 (% vol) hur2_init: Initial water content horizon 2 (% vol) Soil profile: lim_inf_z1: Bottom depth horizon 1 (cm) lim_inf_z2: Bottom depth horizon 2 (cm) profsoil: Maximum soil depth (cm) Soil water retention: humin_1: Wilting point horizon 1 (% vol) hucc_1: Field capacity horizon 1 (% vol) humin_2: Wilting point horizon 2 (% vol) hucc_2: Field capacity horizon 2 (% vol) Soil evaporation: argi_1: Clay content horizon 1 (%) da_1: Bulk density horizon 1 (g cm-3) aclim: Evaporation climate parameter (mm) flag_ha: Logical, use residual water content evaporation stopping q0: Threshold evaporation phases (mm) weather_station named list weather station parameters. lat: Latitude weather station (decimal degrees) z: Elevation weather station sea level (m) practices named list crop management initialization parameters. sowing_year: Beginning year simulation (YYYY) doy_sowing: Day year sowing doy_stop_sim: End simulation (DOY, 730 days sowing) zrac0: Planting depth (cm) density: Plant density (plant m-2) plant named list plant parameters. Phenology: tcmin: Base temperature (°C) tcopt: Optimal temperature (°C) tcxstop : Temperature phenological development stops (°c) flag_vern: Vernalization sensitivity (logical) jvc: Vernalization requirement (days) tfroid: Optimal vernalization temperature (°C) ampfroid: Vernalization temperature range (°C) flag_photo: Photoperiod sensitivity (logical) phobase: Minimum photoperiod (h) phosat: Saturation photoperiod (h) Development: st2germinate: Sowing–germination thermal time (°Cd) st2emerge: Germination–emergence (°Cd cm-1) stlevamf: Emergence–1st node (°Cd) stamflax: 1st node–flag leaf (°Cd) stlevdrp: Emergence–flowering (°Cd) stdrpmat: Flowering–maturity (°Cd) Root growth: croirac: Root front growth rate (cm °Cd-1) Root density: kmax: Maximum crop coefficient (-) zlabour: Tillage depth (cm) zpente: Root density decay depth (cm) zprlim: Maximum rooting depth (cm) lvopt: Optimal root density (cm root cm-3 soil) Leaf area index: adens: Competition parameter bdens: Density threshold (plants m-2) dlaimax: Max LAI growth rate pentlaimax: LAI shape parameter vlaimax: LAI inflection parameter Biomass: parsurg: PAR fraction extin: Light extinction coefficient rue: Radiation use efficiency (g MJ-1) temin: minimal temperature plant growth (°C) teopt: minimum range optimal temperature plant growth (°C) teoptbis: maximum range optimal temperature plant growth (°C) temax: Maximal temperature plant growth stops (°C) Water stress: tetstomate: Soil water threshold stomatal closure (% vol) Grain Yield : nbjgrain : Number days prior flowering preceding onset filling impacting grain number set (days) cgrain : species-dependent parameters accounting slope relationship vitmoy - nbgrains (m^2.g^-1) nbgrainmax : genetic-dependent parameter setting maximal number grains (grains.m^-2) nbgrainmin : genetic-dependent parameter setting minimal number grains (grains.m^-2) vitircarbt : slope linearly increase dynamic harvest index thermal time (g_grain. g_biomass^-1.dc-day^-1) irmax : maximal harvest index (-) pgrainmaxi : maximal weight grains 0% water content (g) tminremp : minimal temperature grain filling (°C) tmaxremp : maximal temperature grain filling (°C) weather data.frame containing daily weather data used forcing miniSTICS model. data.frame must contain following columns: Date: Date observation (dd/mm/yyyy) ANNEE: Year observation DOY: Day year (1–365/366) Temp_min: Minimum air temperature (°C) Temp_moy: Mean air temperature (°C) Temp_max: Maximum air temperature (°C) Radiation: Incoming global radiation (MJ m-2 day-1) Rain: Precipitation (mm) Wind: Wind speed (m s-1) Rel_Hum: Relative humidity (%) Photoperiod: Day length (hours) columns required must contain missing values

title: Run the miniSTICS crop model — miniSTICS
text: model particularly suited crops sensitive vernalization photoperiod, winter wheat, organized sequence modules describing phenology, water balance, biomass accumulation. scientific basis STICS simplified formulations can found : Brisson et al. (1998), Agronomie, 18(5–6), 311–346. Tremblay & Wallach (2004), Agronomie, 24(6–7), 351–365. Beaudoin et al. (2023), STICS soil-crop model: Conceptual framework, equations uses. model sequentially computes: (1) phenological development, (2) leaf area expansion, (3) root growth water uptake, (4) soil water balance, (5) biomass accumulation partitioning (6) grain number grain yield (7) water budget
